Hero.text: Cudjoe is the leader of a community of self-liberated akan known as Maroon Warriors.
Zea is the wife of Cudjoe, she is known to be a ruthless Warrior.
Joejoe is the son of Cudjoe, who is determined to make a name for himself as the most vicious.
Nyla is the wife of Joejoe, she is known to be a intelligent.
Accompong is Cudjoe's brother and a feared warrior, he leads the Accompong Warriors from the highlands.
Akosua is the wife of Accompong, respected among the Maroon clans for her calm counsel in times of war.
Naquan is the elder statesman of the Maroons whose rebellion first broke the chains of the Southern Empire.
Yaa is the wife of Naquan and keeper of Akan custom, her wisdom guides the Windward Maroons through hardship.
